item.title: Kentucky’s first digital ID available through free, secure phone app accepted for air travel
item.description: Gov. Andy Beshear announced on Tuesday that Kentuckians can download Kentucky Mobile ID – a secure digital version of a standard or REAL ID driver’s license or ID accepted for air travel at more than 250 airports.
